headline: How to Find All My Subscriptions: A One Hour Sweep, Step by Step
items: Download twelve months of statements for every credit card, debit card and checking account you've used.
Search or scan each statement for repeats.
Open your Apple subscription list.
Log in to PayPal on the website and go to Settings, then Payments, then Subscriptions and saved businesses
Search your email for the words receipt, invoice, renewal, subscription, trial
Add up the yearly cost of each one.

headline: Charged After Canceling a Subscription? Five Steps, Company First, Then Your Card Issuer
sub: Work up the ladder one rung at a time, and keep every note and email.
items: The day you see the charge | Contact the company again, referring to your confirmation.
Same week, if it isn't fixed | Call the number on the back of your card.
Within 60 days of the statement | Send the card issuer a written billing error notice.
Paying from a bank account | Tell the company in writing that you revoke permission to charge you
After all of that | Report it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov or to your state attorney general's office.

headline: How to Cancel a Subscription When They Push Back: What to Say, Word for Word
sub: Keep it short and polite, and say the same thing again if you need to. You don't owe a reason.
items: They offer a discount: Thank you, but I'd like to cancel today. Please confirm the end date.
They say to call in: I'd like to cancel. What do you need from me to finish it today?
Only chat is available: Please cancel it now and send me written confirmation.
They keep stalling: I've asked to cancel three times. Please give me a reference number for this request and tell me the date it takes effect.
